systems.system: Système national automatisé et sécurisé du registre central du casier judiciaire
systems.tiers: draft decree approved by the Council of Ministers on 27 August 2026; to interconnect courts, prosecution services and the competent central services; no police station or gendarmerie brigade named

note: The only system in the field is the criminal-record central register, an identification system run by the justice ministry and linking courts and prosecutors; the document says nothing of how police stations or gendarmerie brigades record reports or cases.
